inj.note: After the Packers designated Parsons for return from injured reserve Wednesday, he logged three straight limited sessions as he ramps up for his first game action since Dec. 14, 2025 in Denver, when he tore the ACL in his left knee. Parsons himself told reporters that he won't "pinpoint a day" for his return, but his 21-day window conveniently ends on Wednesday, Nov. 25, when the Packers take on the Rams in Los Angeles.

news.h: Packers give Micah Parsons boost in return from ACL injury
news.d: Green Bay hopes Parsons will be back before Thanksgiving as it remains in the playoff hunt.

news.h: Packers open Micah Parsons' practice window; still mum on return
news.d: The Packers opened Micha Parsons' 21-day window to practice while still on the PUP list, but the All-Pro edge avoided giving a firm return date.

news.h: Packers expect Parsons at practiceometime this week'
news.d: Packers defensive end Micah Parsons will practice this week for the first time since he tore the ACL and meniscus in his left knee Dec. 14 of last year.

news.h: Sources: Packers, Micah Parsons target return for Thanksgiving Eve game vs. Rams
news.d: The Packers and Micah Parsons are targeting the Thanksgiving Eve game against the Rams for his return to the field.

news.h: Why Micah Parsons' ACL recovery is taking longer than Patrick Mahomes'
news.d: They were injured the same day, but while Mahomes was ready for Week 1, Parsons has yet to practice.
